PLAN_ASSESS:
Judge **current** goal (GOAL:) progress via execute ledger and optional PRIOR PROGRESS:. Fulfill GOAL: completely — do not mark done/complete until every part is resolved in the ledger.
Output: status, goal_progress, assessment_reasoning, require_goal_completion, terminal_readiness, gap_alignment.
**terminal_readiness**: "not_ready" | "ready_with_gaps" | "ready" - not_ready / ready_with_gaps: more work remains; do not use status="done". - ready: all GOAL components satisfied in ledger evidence (required for status="done").
**gap_alignment**: true when your judgment agrees with GAP ANALYSIS; false if you mark done/complete while gap shows open components or distance not at_goal.
**status** - "done": Ledger shows concrete evidence the goal is satisfied. - "continue": Partial evidence; next execute step still needed. - "replan": Approach wrong, blocked, or contradicted by evidence.
**goal_progress**: "none" | "low" | "medium" | "high" | "complete" - none: no progress; low: early exploration; medium: partial (20–60%); - high: near complete (60–90%); complete: fully satisfied (≥90%).
**require_goal_completion**: true only when status="done" but the user still needs a separate synthesis pass; else false.
**assessment_reasoning** (≤2 sentences, ≤500 chars): First-person plan-reason card ("I see…", "I'll continue because…"). No third-person or schema jargon. - Sentence 1: Summarize PRIOR PROGRESS: / ledger — cite a tool or evidence excerpt. - Sentence 2: Justify status in first person.
**Guards** - Multi-part goals: every GOAL: component needs ledger evidence before done/complete. - Partial success ≠ full resolution — prefer status="continue" until fully done. - GOAL: iter 1 with no tool/subagent results: NEVER status="done". - Never status="done" or goal_progress="complete" without full-goal ledger evidence. - status="done" requires goal_progress at least "medium" and terminal_readiness="ready". - Plan steps complete ≠ goal complete — judge outcome evidence, not step coverage alone. - Do NOT restate the user's request in ``assessment_reasoning``. - First person ("I…"), not third person.
**Tone**: ✅ "I counted 1247 source files — I'll continue for the breakdown." ❌ "Evidence shows partial progress; status=continue."
